interruptions.reason: Original named Colab session absent; two other account GPU sessions occupy slots; five-minute allocation retries.

stage_timing_notes.GPU_run: Lower bound: complete resumed pilot+confirmation pipeline wall span plus original completed retrieval timings. Exact end of vanished original GPU session is unavailable, so lost startup/idle time cannot be allocated accurately. This is pipeline elapsed time, not a GPU kernel profiler.
stage_timing_notes.setup: Time until initial scripts-ready marker; excludes subsequent recovery and installation.
stage_timing_notes.writeup: Elapsed since publication preparation started, overlapping GPU run and evaluation. Stages are not additive.
stage_timing_notes.total: Exact wall time since original experiment start, including interruptions, slot waiting, recovery, GPU pipeline, evaluation and publication preparation.
